( IA No. 227927/2024 - CONDONATION OF DELAY IN FILING & 
 227932/2024 - EXEMPTION FROM FILING O.T.)
 Date : 04-10-2024 These matters were called on for hearing today.
 CORAM :
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SUDHANSHU DHULIA  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE AHSANUDDIN AMANULLAH

For Petitioner(s) Mr. Sachin Patil, AOR  Mr. Geo Joseph, Adv.
 Mr. Risvi Muhammed, Adv.
 Mr. Rishabh Agarwal, Adv.

For Respondent(s)
 UPON hearing the counsel the Court made the following  O R D E R Delay condoned.
The petitioner is an accused for the offences punishable under Sections 304B, 306, 323 & 498A of the Indian Penal Code.
His petition under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for quashing of criminal proceedings has been dismissed by the High Court.

sentences.text: Since, the charges have not yet been framed, the petitioner would always be at liberty to file an application for discharge before the Court concerned which shall be considered on its own merit and in accordance with law.
We see absolutely no reason to interfere in the order passed by the High Court, in exercise of our jurisdiction under Article 136 of the Constitution of India.
The present petition is, accordingly, dismissed with the aforesaid liberty Pending application(s), if any, shall stand disposed of.
